emma (external-auditor): Hi team — auditor request: please produce a compact evidence bundle that links RBAC changes to any vulnerability triage or incidents during the Oct rotation window. We need mapping to ISO A.9 and SOC2 CC6.1, plus one sample of the alert/playbook that triggered an on-call response. Time window: 2025-10-01..2025-10-10.

lina (eng-security): Will do. Quick notes on pipeline: infra role changes are authored as PRs in repo `infra/iam-config`, approvals require 2 reviewers (one sec, one infra). Merge triggers `ci-bot` to run policy-checker and then `deployer` creates the IaC change which generates CloudTrail IAM events and a deploy audit record.

raj (infra): Splunk/ELK queries to pull raw events for that window: 
```
index=aws_cloudtrail eventName=AttachRolePolicy OR eventName=PutRolePolicy OR eventName=UpdateAssumeRolePolicy earliest="2025-10-01T00:00:00" latest="2025-10-10T23:59:59" | table _time, userIdentity.userName, eventName, requestParameters, sourceIPAddress
```
KMS policy changes/rotation: 
```
index=aws_cloudtrail eventName=PutKeyPolicy OR eventName=EnableKeyRotation OR eventName=DisableKeyRotation earliest=2025-10-01 latest=2025-10-10 | table _time, eventName, requestParameters.keyId, userIdentity.userName
```
Add `| where userIdentity.userName!="automation-bot"` to show human approvals.

zoe (sre): For alert/playbook linkage: we have a Datadog monitor that watches for IAM events touching KMS-owned principals. Rule: if AttachRolePolicy OR PutKeyPolicy occurs on a key owner tag=prod within 1h of any suspicious KMS Decrypt event -> fire alert. Alert creates INC ticket via webhook and runs playbook run id. Example Datadog rule name: `IAM-KMS-Privilege-Change-Alert`.

emma (external-auditor): Can you paste a sanitized log sample showing the approver and the playbook trigger? Auditor will accept redacted usernames.

lina (eng-security): Paste sanitized extracts: 
```
_time: 2025-10-04T09:21:33Z | userName: raj-infra | eventName: AttachRolePolicy | roleName: service-secrets-reader | requestParameters:{"policyArn":"arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/SecretsManagerReadOnly"}
_time: 2025-10-04T09:21:50Z | userName: ci-bot | eventName: UpdateAssumeRolePolicy | roleName: deployer | requestParameters:{"policyDocument":"<redacted>"}
_time: 2025-10-05T02:00:05Z | userName: kms-rotator | eventName: EnableKeyRotation | requestParameters.keyId: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/rot-001 | detail:"rotation schedule enabled"
```
Playbook alert extract (Datadog webhook payload sanitized): 
```
alert: IAM-KMS-Privilege-Change-Alert
fired_at: 2025-10-04T09:22:12Z
linked_incident: INC-902
playbook_run: play-2025-10-04-0092 (auto-remediation disabled; on-call paged)
```

raj (infra): Evidence locations (new folder): s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/q4-2025-v2/rbac-kms-linkage/ — contains: `cloudtrail-iam-2025-10-01-10.csv`, `cloudtrail-kms-2025-10-01-10.csv`, `ci-bot-audit-log-2025-10-01-10.csv`, signed manifest `evidence-manifest-v2-2025-10-11.sha256`, and `control-crosswalk-iso-soc2-v2.xlsx`.

emma (external-auditor): Did any RBAC merges spawn a vuln triage? Looking for vulnerability ticket refs or ops followups.

lina (eng-security): Yes — PR #789 merged 2025-10-04 caused additional permission to `service-secrets-reader`. Post-merge we detected an unusual decrypt pattern on 2025-10-04 09:40 UTC; auto-alert created INC-902 and vulnerability ticket VULN-77 (SEC-310 as triage). The chain: PR -> cloudtrail event -> Datadog alert -> INC-902 -> VULN-77 triage issue -> SEC-311 postmortem. All ticket links included in the manifest.

zoe (sre): Relevant ticket notes (sanitized): 
```
INC-902: 2025-10-04T09:22 UTC - Alert: IAM-KMS-Privilege-Change-Alert. On-call paged. Action: rotated temporary creds, revoked role session for user:svc-temp. Post-incident: approval note added to PR #789 and sec review required for similar changes.
VULN-77 / SEC-310: Triage entry: elevated access to KMS observed; risk rated medium; remediation: reduce scope of policy and require explicit KMS key condition.
```

emma (external-auditor): Good. Auditor also wants the control mapping narrative sentence for each event type (single-line is fine).

lina (eng-security): I added single-line mappings in the crosswalk doc. Examples: 
- AttachRolePolicy -> ISO A.9.2 (user access provisioning) -> "Role attachment shows two-person review and CI gating; CloudTrail entry proves change."
- PutKeyPolicy -> ISO A.10.1 (crypto key management) & SOC2 CC6.1 -> "Key policy modification recorded in CloudTrail and mirrored to compliance bucket; alerts tied to owner tag."

raj (infra): Notes on chain of custody: all exports are signed by `ci-bot` GPG key and checksums stored in SSM parameter `/compliance/q4-2025-v2/manifest-sha256`. Retention: evidence bucket set to immutable snapshot with 60d freeze then long-term archive.

ci-bot: evidence-snapshot created: compliance-q4-v2-2025-10-11-001 -> uploaded to s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/q4-2025-v2/rbac-kms-linkage/package-v2.tar.gz; manifest path: s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/q4-2025-v2/rbac-kms-linkage/evidence-manifest-v2-2025-10-11.sha256.

emma (external-auditor): Perfect. I'll pull the package and validate checksums + crosswalk. If we need raw event JSON contexts I'll ask for short-term access. Thanks — this should be sufficient to map to ISO A.9 and SOC2 CC6.1.

lina (eng-security): Thanks — ping us here if you need additional redactions or raw contexts.
